$comment: CBD-126. Every pairing the token system permits, with the WCAG 2.2 AA minimum it must meet in both themes. `kind` is text (4.5:1), non-text (3:1, for boundaries and indicators that identify a control), or exempt (measured and recorded, not enforced, with the clause that exempts it). scripts/check-tokens.mjs measures each pairing from the light-dark() values in tokens.css, fails naming the pairing and the theme, and writes contrast-record.md.

pairings.use: Body text on the page ground.
Body text on cards, inputs, dialogs, and the select picker.
Secondary text: hints, eyebrows, table headers, state labels.
Secondary text inside a raised surface, including alert bodies.
Placeholder text in inputs. Placeholder is text and is not exempt.
Placeholder text in a control sitting directly on the page ground.
Links and the checked select option, on the page ground.
Links inside cards and the select picker.
Error messages under fields and in the table error row.
Alert titles in the danger tone.
Primary button label.
Danger button label.
Control boundary of inputs and selects on the page ground (WCAG 1.4.11).
Control boundary inside a card, and the select picker's edge.
Focus ring against the page ground. The ring sits 2px outside every control, so the surface is what it is adjacent to.
Focus ring against a raised surface.
Error border on an invalid control (2px), also judged as a boundary.

pairings.exemption: The ring is offset 2px onto the surface and never touches the fill; the governing pairings are focus on surface and on surface-raised.
pairings.use: Focus ring around a primary button.

pairings.exemption: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts text of inactive components.
pairings.use: Disabled labels and disabled link text.

pairings.exemption: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts text of inactive components.
pairings.use: Disabled control text inside a raised surface.

pairings.exemption: WCAG 1.4.11: the fill's boundary is not required to identify the control; its on-accent label (a text pairing above) does. No control may rely on this fill alone.
pairings.use: Primary button fill on the page ground.
Primary button fill inside a card or dialog.

pairings.exemption: Decorative separation between regions; WCAG 1.4.11 applies to boundaries needed to identify a component.
pairings.use: Card edges, table row lines, section frames.
Row lines inside a table on a raised surface.
